title: Sin City Skydiving
specs: Jumper Requirements: All jumpers must be at least 18 years old with a photo ID, weigh 230 pounds or less (Weight surcharges will apply for jumpers 201lb and above), height/weight proportionate, and be in good physical and mental health.
You must be 100% Alcohol & Drug Free -- absolutely no alcohol or illegal drugs may be in your system when you arrive for your jump.
Every jumper needs to bring a government issued photo ID with them -- NO EXCEPTIONS.

Group 6 or more must contact the office for further details ALL cancellation and/or reschedule requests MUST be done in writing either via EMAIL or FAX to validate the date and time of the cancellation and/or reschedule request.

services.desc: Skydive Las Vegas | Open 7 Days a week, 365 days a year | Free Transportation Summer Rates Early Bird Special: $199 per jumper Summer Special: $219 per jumper Duration 4 Hours It’s time to get ready for the most extraordinary ride of your life! We are the largest and longest running skydiving center in Nevada; we've been open since 1993. Skydive Las Vegas operates 7 days a week 365 days a year, even on holidays. We are the original, full-time Las Vegas skydiving center specializing in first-time tandem skydives. We are the only Las Vegas area skydiving center that has a landing area right next to our facility. This allows for family and friends to see you take off, watch you in free fall
